assessments.reasoning: I checked the publisher's verified v3.13.0 tag against its exact commit, independently fetched the exact official file over HTTPS, and verified its byte digest. I read the frozen cited passage (except* clause, lines 332–343 and 380–387). The cited except* text expressly allows multiple clauses to handle separate matching parts while assigning each contained exception to at most its first matching clause. Adjacent text explains reraising leftovers and handler failures. The narrow handler received ValueError. The broader handler received only LookupError. Reraising leftovers and the special wrapping of ungrouped exceptions do not contradict the scoped grouping rule.
